title: Generic APIs and Type-Safe Abstractions

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Generic APIs and Type-Safe Abstractions** as part of **Generics and Type-System Design**. Use interfaces and inheritance when they express substitutability, and prefer composition when an object should contain or coordinate collaborators. Use the subtopics—Repository and Container Interfaces, Generic Factories, Reducing Unsafe Casts—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: These concepts help you model domain rules and reusable APIs. Good boundaries reduce accidental mutation, unsafe casts, and code that is difficult to extend.

items.title: Repository and Container Interfaces
items.text: Repository and Container Interfaces should support a clear object invariant: make valid states easy to represent, restrict mutation to the intended API, and keep initialization and dependencies explicit.
